summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes plus None, string, and Literal checks. The 41 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the shared venv. ruff, black, isort, and mypy are not installed there, so lint and type checks were verified by reading the code only: no lines exceed 88 columns and type-ignore placement was checked by hand. No existing modules were changed and nothing was committed.
